title: lambda.json
description: Config file for a Lambda function in the lambdas/ directory. Place this at lambdas/<function-name>/lambda.json.

description.description: Human-readable description shown in the Lambda console.

architecture.description: CPU architecture. arm64 = Graviton (cheaper, faster). x86_64 = Intel/AMD.

runtime.description: Lambda runtime. Use provided.al2023 for Rust/custom runtimes.

memoryMB.description: Lambda memory in MB. Also affects CPU allocation proportionally.

envVars.description: Environment variables injected into the Lambda at runtime.

fromStack.description: Reference a stack output. CDK resolves this at synth time — no hardcoding needed.

s3Access.description: S3 access grants. Keys are bucket prefixes (no trailing slash). Values are arrays of allowed actions.

apiGateway.description: Wires this Lambda to API Gateway. Omit if you don't need an HTTP endpoint.

methods.description: HTTP methods to allow. OPTIONS is handled automatically by CORS preflight — you can include it but it's a no-op.

cognitoAuthorizer.description: Attach the Cognito JWT authorizer. The Lambda still checks cognito:groups itself for group-level auth.
